payload.core_mechanism_summary: Stack-based greedy cancellation: for each 0 after a 1, pop the 1, leaving a non-decreasing stack; uncanceled positions set to 0 maximizes zeros while preserving LNDS equality.
payload.rationale: Algorithm makes greedy local choice (cancel 1-0 pair). Correctness relies on exchange argument; no sorting/heap/two-pointers. Fits greedy_exchange_argument subtype.
